'''The Swallow Takes Flight''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. 

==In practice==
This form was used in the duel between [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Turak Aladon]]. The other person used [[Parting the Silk]] to counter it.{{ref/book|2|45}} [[Eamon Valda]] used this form to counter [[Galadedrid Damodred]]'s use of [[Threading the Needle]] during thier [[Trial Beneath the Light]].{{ref/book|11|p}}
